children: Jazeera Airways has announced a strategic partnership with Trip.com Group aimed at expanding the Kuwaiti low-cost carrier’s global reach, increasing early bookings and supporting the country’s travel and tourism sector.

Under the agreement, Trip.com will use its global user base, predictive demand tools and multi-market technology to strengthen Jazeera Airways’ network, particularly on new and demand-sensitive routes. The collaboration will focus on increasing visibility, generating demand and driving bookings across both origin and destination markets.

Jazeera Airways CEO Barathan Pasupathi said: “This partnership with Trip.com Group marks a significant step in our distribution and growth strategy. By tapping into their global demand ecosystem and cutting-edge AI retailing capabilities, we’re not only accelerating network performance but also enhancing how we reach, engage, and convert travelers. We look forward to jointly shaping Kuwait’s positioning as both a vibrant tourism destination and an efficient transit hub.”

CT Ooi, Chief Executive Officer of Flights, Trip.com Group, said: “By combining Jazeera’s network and local market expertise with Trip.com’s global reach, demand intelligence and technology capabilities, we can help connect the airline with high-potential traveller segments across key international markets. Our goal is to shed light on new and emerging routes, while helping travellers discover more of what Kuwait has to offer. We look forward to working closely with Jazeera to support the growth of Kuwait’s tourism and aviation ecosystem.”

The companies will also promote Kuwait as a stopover and tourism destination through curated content, dynamic travel packages and regional storytelling, supporting efforts to diversify the economy and increase inbound tourism.

Jazeera Airways will gain access to Trip.com’s distribution and retailing technology, helping it target segments including students, expatriates and visiting friends and relatives. The tools will also support fare bundling, ancillary sales and upselling opportunities.

The partnership will further increase Jazeera Airways’ visibility through Trip.com’s media platforms, co-branded campaigns and customer relationship management activities, designed to build awareness, engagement and bookings.
The collaboration is expected to strengthen Jazeera Airways’ international distribution while supporting Kuwait’s broader ambitions to develop its aviation and tourism sectors.

title: ZAWYA: Jazeera Airways partners with Trip.com Group to expand global reach
